# Owner-compacted Market Picture frames

The owner serves frames exactly as `builder.py` seals them:
`MarketPictureFrameV1.model_dump(mode="json", exclude_none=True, exclude_defaults=True)`, with
`flow_ref` kept explicit, then `frame_snapshot_id`/`frame_payload_digest` over the compact mapping.
Null and default-valued fields are therefore absent on the wire, unlike the explicit fixtures above.

These files are that compaction of the explicit fixtures, generated by `generate.py` with the
owner's own model, digest functions and `validate_market_picture_frame(for_production=False)`
(every file is owner-valid):

- hummingbot-api `a0a6b93664b3014cca4c2c406ad740cfd97baecd`
- hummingbot `97a2ae6a5d2352e418295be3d21164968f43286b`

Command (from a hummingbot-api checkout, with the matching hummingbot package on `PYTHONPATH`):
`python generate.py <condor>/tests/fixtures <out> <fixture>[:variant] ...`

Variants: `no-embedded-microstructure` (live frames serve microstructure as a separate companion)
and `unavailable-anomaly` (an hourly anomaly with no valid instruments, whose counts are omitted).
